motivation: Previous real experiment: no correct posterior recovery in 96 wrong-input calls; 92 agreed with wrong tool. These were 12 independent synthetic cells.
arms: same check plus nonnumeric deterministic audit report
same check and report plus corrected inputs and exact recalculation
frozen_size: 12 fresh cells x 2 complements x 4 input cases x 4 arms = 384 real model calls
primary_descriptive_endpoints: report minus explicit-check posterior MAE under duplicated inputs
repair minus explicit-check posterior MAE under duplicated inputs
report minus explicit-check posterior MAE under omitted inputs
repair minus explicit-check posterior MAE under omitted inputs
analysis_unit: Average label complements within reliability-pair cell; no cross-batch pooling or significance claims.
gate: Repair at least 95% posterior-correct at absolute tolerance 1e-4 across 96 repair calls, zero invalid repair outputs, at most one previously correct valid-input control lost. This gate permits engineering follow-up, not an efficacy or publication claim.
if_gate_fails: Do not rerun seeds, tune on this batch, or enlarge sample. Diagnose and discuss implications for manuscript before further model inference.
if_gate_passes: Design recipient-specific multi-agent tests with a conventional origin-aware deterministic baseline, fair evidence and compute controls. Do not automatically claim novelty from input checking.
limitations: trusted complete registry supplied by experiment
conditioned coincident observations, not natural prevalence
no natural communication or real-task utility evaluated
